title: fix(objectql): deleting a record clears a read-only lookup that points at it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBQ3DFv6XZAspQRYGQoEWhr8)_
Fixes #34899
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgNCAXyGfBQFZBwixH

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:删除一条记录时,引擎会把指向它的 lookup 清空(`set_null`)。现在即使这个 lookup 是只读(`readonly` 或 `readonlyWhen`)也能清空,且不再打印 "DROPPED" 警告。
- **为什么改**:以前只读规则把引擎自己的清空当成调用方伪造的写入并丢掉,删除返回 200,引用行却一直挂着已删除记录的 id(hotcrm 的工时条目因此"永远显示已开票")。
- **风险与回滚**:豁免只覆盖删除流程清空的那一个字段、那一个值,而且只通过引擎内部的私有 Symbol 传递,调用方无法伪造;回滚即 revert 本 PR。已知影响:回收站恢复对只读 lookup 的重新关联会被只读规则剥掉(见 Acceptance notes),需要决定是否另行修复。
- **先看**:`packages/objectql/src/engine-update.ts`(豁免的构造,约 :282-300)、`packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts`(`isReferentialClear` 与两处跳过)、`packages/objectql/src/engine-cascade-planning.ts`(删除流程传入私有选项,约 :1153-1170)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/engine-set-null-readonly-lookup-clear.test.ts`,预期 13/13 通过。
- **需要你做的**:决定回收站恢复的只读 lookup 重新关联(ADR-0148)是否在本 PR 一并修复,还是另立卡。

## What changes

Deleting a record makes the engine clear every optional lookup pointing at it (`set_null`, the default) with an UPDATE of the holder under the caller's context. The update-side read-only strip runs on `!context.isSystem` and never read the walk's marker, so on a `readonly: true` lookup it dropped the clear and logged `Field 'billed_on' on 'ro_entry' is read-only: the caller-supplied value was DROPPED and the update is being COMMITTED WITHOUT IT`. The delete answered 200 and the holder kept the deleted id. A `readonlyWhen`-locked lookup failed the same way.

The fix:

- `engine-top-level.ts`: a module-private `REFERENTIAL_CLEAR_OPTION` symbol, the shape of the ADR-0142 D4 `WRITE_PRECONDITION_OPTION`. It is not re-exported from `index.ts` or `core.ts`, and no `.d.ts` of the built package names it.
- `engine-cascade-planning.ts`: the walk passes `{ object, id, field }` of the holder row and lookup on that symbol, next to the unchanged `referentialCtx`.
- `engine-update.ts`: `update()` turns the option into a `ReferentialClearExemption { field, value }`. It does this only on the by-id write of the row and object the walk named, with `value` taken from the entry snapshot. It hands the exemption to the hide-from-hooks pass, the `readonlyWhen` strips (FK settlement and the main pass), the stored view those read, and the static strip.
- `rule-validator.ts`: `isReferentialClear(data, name, exemption)` is true only for `name === field` while the key still holds `value` by `Object.is`. The static strip keeps that key and logs nothing for it. The `readonlyWhen` strip does not judge it. Every other key is judged exactly as before.
- `recycle-bin/restore.ts` (ADR-0148 D2, claim amendment 6956936802): the restore's re-link of a cleared reference, and that re-link's undo when a restore fails partway, now pass `{ object, id, field }` on the same module-private `REFERENTIAL_CLEAR_OPTION`. `update()` builds the same one-key exemption from it, only on the by-id write of the row and object the restore names, at the value the restore writes. So a `readonly` / `readonlyWhen` lookup is re-linked under the caller's context instead of stripped. It is not `isSystem`, and it is not the `__referentialFieldClear` marker. `relinked` now counts a re-link only when a read-back of the row after the write shows it holds the id (`relinkedValue(...) === undefined`). A write that a strip or a hook took the key out of is not counted.

Why a symbol and not the context marker. The ruling asked whether `__referentialFieldClear` can be forged before relying on it. Findings:

- REST and MCP: no. `assembleExecutionContext` (`packages/core/src/security/assemble-execution-context.ts:295-430`, closed `entryFields`) builds the inbound envelope from a closed field set with no `__` key.
- Hook `ctx.api` writes outside a cleanup dispatch: no. `ObjectRepository.update` overrides `context` with the hook's own (`packages/objectql/src/engine-object-repository.ts:83-88`).
- Hook writes inside a cleanup dispatch: they inherit the marker by design (`packages/objectql/src/engine-middleware-and-context.ts:183-187`).
- Other write paths that can carry a caller-shaped context are not relied on either: the exemption does not read the marker at all.

The exemption therefore keys on neither the marker nor `isSystem`. It keys on a value only the walk can hold. A caller carrying the marker gets nothing, and a test pins this.

The multi-value branch is covered. On a `multiple: true` lookup the walk writes the remaining ids, and the exemption is that exact array.

## Tests

New file `packages/objectql/src/engine-set-null-readonly-lookup-clear.test.ts`: real `ObjectQL`, stub driver, the sibling `engine-referential-clear-write-context.test.ts` harness plus `$in` / `$contains`. It pins:

- a readonly lookup reads `null` after its target is deleted, under a user context and under none, with no drop line, and the holder's `beforeUpdate` sees the `null`;
- a readonly multi-value lookup keeps its remaining id (`[a, b]` becomes `[b]`);
- a `readonlyWhen: 'true'` lookup is cleared;
- control: a writable lookup is cleared as before;
- forged: a caller `update` carrying `__referentialFieldClear` and its cause through the normal door is still stripped and logged once, still locked by `readonlyWhen`, and still refused under `strictReadonlyWrites` (`code` `ERR_READONLY_FIELD_REJECTED`, `fields` `['billed_on']`, row unchanged);
- unit, one key and one value wide: a second readonly key in the same payload is stripped and logged; the cleared key at any other value is stripped (static) or locked (`readonlyWhen`).

Restore pins, a top-level describe in `recycle-bin/restore.test.ts` (the restore harness): (1) readonly `set_null` lookup, delete, restore: the reference holds `acc1` again, `relinked` is 1, and no drop line is logged across the delete and the restore. (2) A holder `beforeUpdate` that keeps the stamp empty: the row stays `null` and `relinked` is 0. (3) A caller `update` carrying the option's shape through the normal door (a `Symbol('objectql.referentialClear')` key, a `Symbol.for('objectql.referentialClear')` key, and `__referentialFieldClear` on the context) is still stripped and logs one DROPPED line. A JSON transport cannot carry a symbol key at all. Ablations at head a0f8fd1cd6: re-link without the option gives pin 1 red (`expected +0 to be 1`); counting without the read-back gives pin 2 red (`expected 1 to be +0`); both restored to HEAD by blob. Suite at 326cea5a80: objectql 607/607 files, 13672/13672 tests.

1. `rule-validator.ts`: `return exemption !== undefined` became `return false && exemption !== undefined`. The anchor count went 1 to 0 and the blob changed cb5c7a24af8e to 7c529516591a. Result: 8 failed, 5 passed (the six engine cases and both exemption units). Restore: blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
2. `engine-cascade-planning.ts`: the walk stops passing the symbol (`const clearOptions = { context: referentialCtx };`). Mutation landed (d941938d7c4b to e7d59f666fb7). Result: 6 failed, 7 passed (the six engine cases; the units stay green as expected). Restored: blob equals HEAD.

## Acceptance notes

- **ADR-0148 restore (fixed here, route A, claim amendment 6956936802).** Without the restore half, a readonly lookup's clear now landed, but the restore's caller-context re-link was stripped. The field stayed `null`, a DROPPED line was logged, and `restore()` still counted it in `relinked`. The re-link and its undo now ride the engine's private channel, and `relinked` counts only re-links that landed. The undo leg carries the channel too. It is not pinned separately, because no harness drives a restore that fails after a re-link outside a transaction; it is the same call shape as the pinned forward write.
- Rows that already hold a deleted record's id keep it. The changeset says so.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local gates (head fbe36bf78)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths; change set from merge base d576509c8, 7 paths) derived 71 commands. All 71 ran on fbe36bf78. Each exit code was captured before any pipe.

- 69 answered exit 0.
- 2 answered exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET), read as **NOT MEASURED**:
  - `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`: checker health only. Its pinned fixture commit is unreachable on this shallow checkout.
  - `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: its self-test passed (93 cases). The scan needs every package's `dist/`, and only the objectql closure was built. CI runs it.
- `--ran` reconciliation: `71 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 69 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`.
- No exported symbol was renamed or removed, so `check-platform-checklist --changed-from` does not apply. The built `dist/*.d.ts` names neither `ReferentialClearExemption` nor the symbol, so the public surface is byte-unchanged.
- Full dogfood: n/a. The title carries no `!` and there is no `(narrowing)` arm. `test:repo` was not run locally (CI `Test Core`).
</details>

Overlap: `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=claude/issue-34899-set-null-readonly-lookup`, `VERDICT clean exit 0` against origin/main d576509c80 and #34817, #34811, #34752, #34709. The first run was red on #34709, an import-line conflict in `engine-update.ts`. It was cleared by importing the symbol on its own line.
